_comment: Golden A/B study: 20um soldermask over the feed only (not the enclosed cavity top -- see palace_dualmode_driven.py soldermask_um docstring), same design/launch as the sma_taoglas golden entry. Compare against that entry for the bare-copper baseline.
CORRECTION_2026-09-01: The original save under this filename (commit 024d5b6) is INVALID and has been overwritten. Root cause: topologies/dualmode.py's build_mesh() adapter never forwarded res['soldermask'] (or res['via_conductivity']) from palace_dualmode_driven.py's mesh builder up to optimize.py's _driven_config(), so every soldermask (and via-conductivity) run to date silently ran with NO soldermask material assigned in the Palace config -- Palace defaulted the untagged volume rather than erroring. The old numbers below (bw +28%, S11w -9.95dB) measured that no-op, not the soldermask. Fixed by forwarding both keys in dualmode.py's build_mesh() return dict; this file now holds the first real measurement, reproduced via evaluate(fine=True) (the same wide-window path that produced the bare-copper golden entry) rather than the narrower siw-sweep window the old entry used.

soldermask.note: typical LPI (liquid photoimageable) soldermask values; not measured for a specific vendor product

launch.description: Same as the bare-copper golden entry -- pad-only ground stitching, unchanged.

comparison_vs_bare_copper.conclusion: Modest, real effect: bandwidth is essentially unchanged (318->303MHz, -5%), matched-band return loss degrades by ~4dB (-17.7->-13.6dB, a real detuning from the added capacitance under the feed trace), insertion loss ticks up negligibly (-1.42->-1.46dB, consistent with tan_d=0.02 over a thin, feed-only layer). This supersedes the prior (invalid, no-op) entry's claim of +28% bandwidth and -7.7dB S11w degradation.

provenance.reproduce_with: python -c "from siwfilter.config import FilterSpec; from siwfilter.optimize import evaluate; from siwfilter.topologies.dualmode import DualModeTopology; print(evaluate(DualModeTopology(), FilterSpec(N=2), dict(a=57.21,w_iris=15.26,x_iris=28.68,y_wall=8.62,w_ext=16.31,soldermask_um=20.0), fine=True, np_ranks=8))"
provenance.adapter_fix_commit: uncommitted at save time -- topologies/dualmode.py build_mesh() now forwards res.get('soldermask')/res.get('via_conductivity')
